easyPrerequisites: You are able to animate the land.
description:
Animate the land, if needed.
Activate Trazyn using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping the animated land, putting a number of charge counters on Trazyn equal to the animated land's power.
Activate Trazyn using Lost Jitte's ability by removing a charge counter from it, untapping the animated land.
Repeat from step 2.
